dialogues.speaker: Message Board of Puspa Café
dialogues.text: This is the message board of Puspa Café. For some reason, I will be the Acting Manager of Puspa Café for the time being. If you have anything that you want to let us know, please feel free to leave a message.

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "The legendary story of Antara will continue this week!"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Presented to you by Puspa Café's special resident storyteller, Maddah! Stay tuned!"

dialogues.speaker: Acting Manager's Reply
dialogues.text: Mr. Maddah... We'll offer you a cup of coffee free of charge if you stop posting ads here.

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Hehe... Gata, hehehe..."

dialogues.speaker: Acting Manager's Reply
dialogues.text: Gata seems to be really fond of you too, Miss Nilou.

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "The Puspa Card Club is recruiting members who play Genius Invokation TCG!"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "If you'd like to discuss deck setup and techniques, come find me at the card table!"

dialogues.speaker: Acting Manager's Reply
dialogues.text: Mr. Nayab, at least order a cup of coffee if you're going to play cards here.

dialogues.speaker: Matra's Message
dialogues.text: "There have been several cases of Canned Knowledge smuggling recently."

dialogues.speaker: Matra's Message
dialogues.text: "Matra's special reminder: Please go through the authorized procedure when applying for and obtaining the knowledge you seek."

dialogues.speaker: Matra's Message
dialogues.text: "Forbidden knowledge obtained through illegal channels will result in the revoking of your right to study in the Akademiya. Please be aware."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "The atmosphere here is much more friendly than a tavern for a student like me who is preparing for an exam."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "There's coffee to keep me going and seniors to seek guidance from."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Even the owner predicted that I'll get in the Akademiya this year!"

dialogues.speaker: Acting Manager's Reply
dialogues.text: May your wish come true.

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Be careful, everyone! My friend ran into the Rishboland Raja in the middle of the night in the northwest forest! He was lucky to make it back in one piece. Still, don't go out after sunset!"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "The great researcher Pursina's latest research suggests that drinking coffee improves your cognitive ability."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "If you're trying to get in the Akademiya, then visit this coffee shop often."

dialogues.speaker: Acting Manager's Reply
dialogues.text: I'm very grateful that you're advertising our shop, but coffee will only give you a little more energy... Besides, the Mahamata might take action against unfounded statements like this, right?

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "If you're here to play cards, please learn a lesson from me."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "I shouldn't have made up a non-existent card to deceive my fellow players while playing Genius Invokation TCG."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Lord Jackal has helped me realize my mistakes, and I'm here to confess."

dialogues.speaker: Another Person's Message
dialogues.text: "Most people can't even realize their mistakes. But... who's this Lord Jackal again?"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "I heard many bandits have been popping up in the desert, and many merchants are refusing to travel the routes there. The price of Ajilenakh Nuts might start to skyrocket."

dialogues.speaker: Another Person's Message
dialogues.text: "Awesome! I'm selling all my mushrooms for Ajilenakh Nuts right now! Haha! Perhaps this is the courage and vision of the Alkindi Clan!"

dialogues.speaker: Acting Manager's Reply
dialogues.text: I'd love to see your wealth multiply, but I'd like to state that my shop is not responsible for any losses that may arise from the information on this board.

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "After retiring from the Corps of Thirty, this is where I get my cup of coffee every day."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "The acting manager makes me the same coffee every day, and the storyteller tells the same story."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Perhaps the essence of life in Sumeru lies in repetitions like this."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "The stories Mr. Maddah tell may be old-fashioned, but he's quite skilled when it comes to controlling their pace."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "But everyone's used to getting their information from Akasha now, so they unconsciously overlook such sophistication of technique and artistic maturity."

dialogues.speaker: Another Person's Message
dialogues.text: "You need to be more realistic. No art form is eternal. The day when all of its value has been exploited is the day it loses its reason for existence."

dialogues.speaker: Another Person's Message
dialogues.text: "Like how overripe fruits fall to the earth and provide nourishment for new plants."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "And that is exactly why I've always despised materialists like you. Art is a precious fruit of leisure. You can't compare it to production and exploitation for commercial purposes!"

dialogues.speaker: Another Person's Message
dialogues.text: "Leisurely people are like people walking on a spherical ground — they don't exist. Why don't you use your brain and think for a moment? Can the production of anything exist without commercial exchange?"

dialogues.speaker: Acting Manager's Reply
dialogues.text: "What a sharp clash of theories... Anyway, it's time for Mr. Kaveh to settle his bill for the month. Should it be put on your tab as usual, Mr. Alhaitham?"

dialogues.speaker: Another Person's Message
dialogues.text: "No. That spoiled guy needs to experience the brutality of the business world."

dialogues.speaker: Message Seemingly From a Noble
dialogues.text: "Miss Acting Manager, please put it on Lord Sangemah Bay's tab. After all, one can't make art without coffee!"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "After so many years, this place is still so lively! Every time I come to this coffee shop, I can't help but recall that afternoon I spent arguing with him about the interpretation of a single word."

dialogues.speaker: Acting Manager's Reply
dialogues.text: Our shop wouldn't be so lively without your patronage. Please do visit often.
